consumer: a non-lane operator with a STATUS/sidecar evidence bundle who wants to verify exact other-row coverage and evidence bindings

smallest_scope.snapshot: private copy with manifest and bounded transient classification

why_this_is_smallest: The lane already has the verifier logic, sidecar schema, copy-based arms, normalized digest binding, evidence locator checks, and snapshot contract. Packaging the narrow evidence-bundle verifier is smaller than shipping a new judgment demo or wiring a lane-wide gate.
observed_defect_it_addresses: evidence claims can point at an existing but semantically unsupported receipt, sidecar coverage can drift, and a shared-worktree verifier can observe partial input state

acceptance.positive: A clean bundle exits 0 and prints exact coverage, three-way digest agreement, resolved locators, and a manifest digest.
negative: missing or extra other entry exits nonzero
invalid primary or corroborating locator exits nonzero
unstable two-capture input returns TRANSIENT_UNSTABLE without a verdict
acceptance.installability: one local command plus fixture bundle; no repository-specific absolute paths

retirement_condition: Retire or merge into a stronger evidence-verification tool if an external maintained tool accepts the same bundle contract and passes the same positive/negative fixture matrix.
no_claim: Nothing is packaged, installed, externally validated, or consumed outside this lane yet.
